events.title: GraphQL Foundation announced
events.summary: The Linux Foundation announced the GraphQL Foundation on November 6, 2018 — a vendor-neutral home for the GraphQL specification and ecosystem.
events.about: The foundation stewards the GraphQL spec, reference implementations, and community governance outside any single company. Airbnb, Apollo, GitHub, Shopify, and others joined as members. It marked GraphQL's shift from a Facebook project to industry infrastructure alongside REST and gRPC.

narrative.whyChosen: Neutral governance was the milestone that let enterprises bet on GraphQL long-term.
narrative.whyImportant: It separated the query language from Meta and aligned it with other Linux Foundation open standards.
narrative.problemSolved: A single-vendor spec slowed adoption; the community needed open, versioned stewardship.
